sentences.text: Also heard on I.A.No. 02/2025 an application for grant of stay.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the claims case under 166 of Motor Vehicles Act was filed after a delay of 01 month and 20 days, therefore it was barred by limitation.
Apart from this excessive compensation has also been awarded.

It is ordered that on appellant's depositing 50% out of the total awarded amount before the learned Claims Tribunal with interest within a period of 45 days from today, the recovery of the remaining amount shall remain stayed till next date of hearing.
The respondents/claimants would be entitled to withdraw the deposited amount in accordance with terms of the award.
List after service report is received.
In the meanwhile, call for the records of the Claims Tribunal.
